items.title_en: The Little-Known Story Of Charles Stanley Gifford, Marilyn Monroe’s Father Who Refused To Have Anything To Do With Her
items.title_zh: 玛丽莲·梦露的父亲查尔斯·斯坦利·吉福德鲜为人知的故事，他拒绝与她有任何关系
items.summary_en: Find a Grave Charles Stanley Gifford was confirmed to be Marilyn Monroe’s biological father in 2022. As much as she tried to hide it from the public, Marilyn Monroe, the iconic bombshell of the 1950s, had a tumultuous life before her rise to stardom. And one part of that was the absence of a father figure. But Monroe long suspected that her father was a man named Charles Stanley Gifford.
items.summary_zh: 寻找坟墓 查尔斯·斯坦利·吉福德 (Charles Stanley Gifford) 于 2022 年被确认为玛丽莲·梦露 (Marilyn Monroe) 的亲生父亲。 尽管玛丽莲·梦露 (Marilyn Monroe) 极力向公众隐瞒，但这位 20 世纪 50 年代的标志性性感人物在成为明星之前却经历了一段动荡的生活。其中一个原因是父亲形象的缺失。但梦露长期以来怀疑她的父亲是一个名叫查尔斯·斯坦利·吉福德的人。

items.title_en: Archaeologists Believe They’ve Just Identified Remains From The Original 2,200-Year-Old Settlement Of Paris
items.title_zh: 考古学家相信他们刚刚发现了具有 2200 年历史的巴黎原始定居点的遗迹
items.summary_en: Anastasia Choquet/DRAC Île-de-France Archaeologists excavating a hospital courtyard in Paris discovered a wall that may have been part of Lutetia, the city’s ancient precursor. Archaeologists just discovered an ancient wall beneath a hospital in Paris that they believe was part of the city’s original settlement during the late Iron Age. This roughly 2,200-year-old stretch of wall was found just steps from the Notre Dame Cathedral on the Île de la Cité, an island in the river Seine. It was likely built by the…
items.summary_zh: Anastasia Choquet/DRAC 法兰西岛考古学家在巴黎一座医院庭院的挖掘中发现了一堵墙，这堵墙可能是这座城市古代前身卢泰西亚的一部分。考古学家刚刚在巴黎一家医院下面发现了一堵古老的墙，他们认为这是铁器时代晚期该市最初定居点的一部分。这座大约有 2,200 年历史的城墙被发现于河中岛屿西岱岛上，距巴黎圣母院仅几步之遥

items.title_en: 14 Real Places That Haunt the Pages of Literature
items.title_zh: 14 个经常出现在文学作品中的真实地点
items.summary_en: One of literature’s greatest gifts is its ability to transport us to other worlds: some utopian and fantastical, others dark and unnerving, scary and supernatural ... This guide is all about the latter (which are, arguably, much more fun). These are the novels, short stories, and novellas that get under your skin, that stay in your psyche long after you’ve put them down and returned to the world of the living. Little do folks know that many of these works were inspired by — or, in a few cases, explicitly based on…
items.summary_zh: 文学最伟大的礼物之一就是它能够将我们带到另一个世界：一些是乌托邦和奇幻的世界，另一些是黑暗和令人不安的，可怕的和超自然的......本指南是关于后者的（可以说，后者更有趣）。这些是长篇小说、短篇故事和中篇小说，它们会深入你的内心，在你放下它们并回到生者的世界后，它们会在你的心灵中留下很长一段时间。人们很少知道，其中许多作品的灵感来自于——o
